summary: Iteration 12 testing - merged Stanze inside Immobili, image upload (property/room), email reminders (mocked), notification count, Login redesign, Tenants Contanti/Bonifico dialog. Backend pytest 11/11 PASSED. Frontend mostly works, but found ONE CRITICAL bug: post-login does not auto-redirect to authenticated app (URL stays at /login).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login (200 OK, cookies set, AuthContext.setUser(data) called), the URL stays at /login. The Login form remains visible and user must manually navigate to /properties or /. Root cause: Login.js does NOT call navigate('/') after await login() resolves, AND App.js has no <Navigate to='/'/> for authenticated users hitting /login. ProtectedRoute only handles the inverse (unauth -> /login). Verified by manually navigating to /properties after login, which then works fully (sidebar, badge=4, all menus correct).

Property cards expose only data-testid='property-card-{id}'. There is no data-testid for the expand chevron, the AGGIUNGI STANZA, Aggiungi Foto, or Assegna buttons. Could not automation-verify the expand-shows-rooms flow or the per-room delete/assign/upload buttons via testids. UI screenshots show all 4 properties listed correctly but expansion content not reachable from automation reliably.

issues: Looks great - dark navy gradient with cream card and red accent, brand 'Consulenze immobiliari'. Dark bg + cream card has good contrast.
Order verified: Proprietari, Immobili, Inquilini, Dashboard, Pagamenti, Ospitalita, Registrazione, Contratti, Fatture, Notifiche(4), Report, Gestione Dati. No Stanze. Red badge '4' next to Notifiche.
'Inquilini In Ritardo — April 2026' card renders with 4 red rows showing tenant names + property/room and 'Scadenza: giorno 5'.
ZIP package cards render with both green WA and blue Email badge buttons per tenant. Visually verified.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.js, after `await login(email, password)` succeeds, call `navigate('/')` from useNavigate(). Alternatively in App.js add a guard so authenticated users on /login are redirected to /. Without this, every user has to manually re-navigate after login.
Add data-testid attributes for the expand chevron, 'AGGIUNGI STANZA', 'Aggiungi Foto', and 'Assegna' buttons on Properties page to enable automated regression testing of the new merged-rooms flow.
(Carry-over) Add unique compound index on monthly_status(tenant_id, month, year).
(Carry-over) Replace AuthContext window.alert kick UX with toast/modal.
(Carry-over) Extract shared 'is_late' helper used by /notifications, /notifications/count, dashboard.py, payment_calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py single-admin enforcement: every successful login still invalidates ALL other active sessions via update_many({is_active:True}, {is_active:False}). Same admin re-login from another tab kills original tab. Scope by admin_id != current.
Login.js missing navigate('/') after successful login -- UX-critical; users see stale login form after authenticating.

rooms.py upload endpoints don't validate file mimetype/size -- user can upload arbitrary files (e.g. .exe) and they'll be served from /uploads. Add allowlist {png,jpg,jpeg,webp,gif} and max_size guard.
rooms.py DELETE /rooms/{id}/images and /properties/{id}/images take url as a query param; if url empty, $pull does nothing but still returns 200. Should 400 on empty url.
email_reminders.py: relies on today_day arithmetic (days_until_due == 7) - if cron skips a day, reminder is missed. Should track 'last_reminder_sent_at' per tenant per type to be idempotent.
notifications_routes.py /notifications/count: N+1 queries (one monthly_status + one payments lookup per tenant). Will scale poorly past ~200 tenants. Aggregate into one $facet query.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (login redirect broken, all other 18 spec items verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_12.xml. The CRITICAL frontend bug to retest is post-login redirect: open /login, submit valid creds, confirm URL changes away from /login automatically (should land on / or /dashboard). Property schema requires number_of_rooms, capacity, rental_amount (NOT total_rooms) - my earlier 422 was a payload mismatch, fixed in test file. All 17 spec checks except 'expand to see rooms' (no testid) and login-auto-redirect (broken) verified live. Hospitality body did not contain literal 'firma'/'Signature' substrings on initial render but is likely behind a form; not classified as a bug, just unverified.
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + sets access_token cookie; AuthContext.setUser(data) is called. However Login.js's handleSubmit does not call navigate after await login() resolves, and App.js has no public-route guard redirecting authenticated users away from /login. Result: setUser triggers a re-render but the route stays /login since no programmatic navigation occurs. Manual fix in Login.js: import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; const navigate = useNavigate(); after `await login(email,password)` add `navigate('/', { replace: true });`. Alternatively add `if (user) return <Navigate to='/' replace />;` at top of Login component.
